title: Planner: add times to task start, finish and due dates
summary: Hold: Microsoft documents plan time zones and working-time settings in its beta Planner API, contrary to the briefing's claim that neither surface is documented. The cited PowerShell example describes unblocking rather than blocking, and the feature's mixed licensing model is not established by the published product licensing.
